senses.gloss: m. (כְּסַף) paring, husk; כ׳ דתמרי substance of ground dates after the juice is pressed out.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 24b:4">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>אכ׳ דת׳ קיימי דקא מזדבן</he> they stand around a mass of ground dates which is to be sold (there being a famine).
<cite ref="Shabbat 50b:5">Sabb. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דיסמין</he> puppy pomace flavored with jasmin (used for a lotion).
